notes: CONFORMS since kb/Work PB5202. §1985:VII.3.4.3 SR1 'all data in that file must be described as USAGE IS DISPLAY and any signed numeric data must be described with the SIGN IS SEPARATE clause'. A file with record description entries is screened by CheckCodeSetRecordItemsPass.Run through CheckCodeSetRecordItem (COBOL1672, every elementary item, unchanged); a report file has none (§1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR4), so at --std 85 Run also screens the printable items of the reports its REPORT clause names (CheckCodeSetReportItems, one verdict per item, the same CheckCodeSetItem predicate): a signed PIC S9(4) report item without SIGN IS SEPARATE is refused COBOL1672 at the item. The report arm is the 1985 text's alone; the 2002 and later wording is over data and record description entries, which a report group description entry is not.

next.reason: 1985: "If the CODE-SET clause is specified for a file, all data in that file must be described as USAGE IS DISPLAY"; 2023: "If there are record description entries associated with the file and no SELECT WHEN clauses are specified ... usage national". The 2023 display rule holds only when record entries exist and there is no SELECT WHEN; with alphabet-name-2 it requires usage national. 1985 required DISPLAY for all data, unconditionally.
